name: Dash0
description: OpenTelemetry-native observability platform. Enables AI agents to query metrics, logs, and traces, investigate production incidents, manage dashboards, and configure alerting rules via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

skills.name: Query Telemetry
skills.description: Query metrics, logs, and traces stored in Dash0 using natural language or structured queries.

skills.name: Investigate Incident
skills.description: Investigate production incidents by correlating metrics, logs, and traces across services.

skills.name: Manage Dashboards
skills.description: Create, update, and retrieve Dash0 dashboards.

skills.name: Configure Alerts
skills.description: Create and manage alerting rules and check rules in Dash0.

skills.name: Explore OpenTelemetry Resources
skills.description: Navigate and inspect OpenTelemetry resources, services, and their relationships.

bearer.description: Dash0 auth token. Create one under Settings → Auth Tokens in the Dash0 app.
